# ui::ThemeColors

Header: `winui/ui/themes/Theme.hpp`.

The theme's colors by role, resolved for the era and mode the theme draws. Every theme fills every field, high contrast included, so a custom control can read these without checking [`Theme::variant`](theme.md#variant) first. [`Theme::palette`](theme.md#palette) (Fluent only), `surfaces` and the button visuals hold the era-specific detail behind them.

A theme's colors are read-only ([`Theme::colors()`](theme.md#colors)), since they are what the theme resolved to. To change them, pass a ThemeColors to `Theme::fluent(colors)` or `Theme::classic(colors, ...)`, which derive a whole theme from it, or set a [`ThemeRequest`](theme-request.md) (`accent_override`, mode, variant) on the window. The defaults are the Fluent light theme's colors, so `ThemeColors{.accent = ...}` describes a light theme with that accent.

New roles are added at the end. A role is never removed or renamed.

Example: 
```cpp
class SwatchControl : public ui::Element
{
protected:
    void render_override(ui::Renderer& r, const ui::RenderContext& context) const override
    {
        const ui::ThemeColors& c      = context.theme.colors();
        const float            radius = context.theme.corner_radius;
        r.fill_rounded_rect(bounds(), radius, is_enabled() ? c.accent : c.control_fill_disabled);
        r.stroke_rounded_rect(bounds(), radius, c.control_stroke, 1.0f);
        r.draw_text(label_, bounds(), c.text_on_accent, context.theme.text_style);
    }

private:
    std::string label_;
};
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0xE4000000)` | Body text on `background`, `card` and `overlay`. [TextControl](../controls/text.md#uitextcontrol)'s default color. |
| `text_secondary` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0x9E000000)` | Less prominent text: captions, descriptions, a placeholder. The same as `text` in an era without a secondary text color. |
| `text_disabled` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0x5C000000)` | The text of a disabled control. |
| `text_on_accent` | `Color` | `colors::White` | [Text](../controls/text.md#uitext) and glyphs drawn on an `accent` fill. |
| `link` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0xFF004275)` | A link's text. [`Surfaces`](surfaces.md) holds its hover, pressed and disabled states. |
| `background` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0xFFF3F3F3)` | The window's own background, which the host clears the window to: the page color in the Fluent eras, the dialog face in the classic ones. |
| `card` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0xB3FFFFFF)` | A raised panel or card on `background`. The same as `background` in an era without cards. |
| `overlay` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0xFFF9F9F9)` | A popup's surface: menus, flyouts, drop-down lists. Under in-app acrylic this is the solid color the material stands in for. |
| `field` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0xB3FFFFFF)` | An editable or scrollable surface, such as a [TextBox](../controls/text-box.md#uitextbox) or a list's rows. |
| `field_text` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0xE4000000)` | [Text](../controls/text.md#uitext) on `field`. |
| `scrim` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0x4D000000)` | The scrim drawn over the window behind an open dialog. 30 % black in every Fluent theme. |
| `accent` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0xFF005A9E)` | The accent fill at rest, on hover and pressed: what an accent [Button](../controls/button.md#uibutton) fills with. |
| `accent_hover` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0xFF005A9E).with_alpha(0.9f)` |  |
| `accent_pressed` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0xFF005A9E).with_alpha(0.8f)` |  |
| `control_fill` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0xB3FFFFFF)` | A control's fill at rest, on hover, pressed and disabled: what a neutral [Button](../controls/button.md#uibutton) fills with. |
| `control_fill_hover` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0x80F9F9F9)` |  |
| `control_fill_pressed` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0x4DF9F9F9)` |  |
| `control_fill_disabled` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0x4DF9F9F9)` |  |
| `control_stroke` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0x0F000000)` | A control's outline: a neutral [Button](../controls/button.md#uibutton)'s border. |
| `control_stroke_strong` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0x72000000)` | The stronger outline of an unchecked box, a slider track or a field's border. |
| `divider` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0x0F000000)` | A divider line between groups of content. The Fluent eras draw it as one flat stroke. The classic eras draw an etched groove from [`Surfaces::separator_light`](surfaces.md) and `separator_dark` instead, as [`Theme::divider_visual`](theme.md#divider_visual) says. |
| `selection` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0xFF005A9E)` | A selected item's fill and its text. |
| `selection_text` | `Color` | `colors::White` |  |
| `focus` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0xE4000000)` | The keyboard focus visual: the outer ring (also the classic eras' dotted rectangle) and the inner ring inside it. |
| `focus_inner` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0xB3FFFFFF)` |  |
| `critical` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0xFFC42B1C)` | The strong severity fills: [InfoBar](../controls/info-bar.md#uiinfobar)'s icon disc, an error message, a warning mark. |
| `caution` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0xFF9D5D00)` |  |
| `success` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0xFF0F7B0F)` |  |
| `informational` | `Color` | `Color::from_argb(0xFF005A9E)` |  |
